_meta.note: Skill invocation dependency map. 'calls' covers ALL code paths — both required and optional. If skill A ever calls skill B, B must be 'on'. Step 2.5 enforces this transitively for all skills with value != 'off'.
_meta.rule: For each skill K in preset with value != 'off': for each dep D in dependencies[K].calls: preset[D] must be 'on'
_meta.how_to_update: 1. Find SKILL.md of the caller skill  2. Grep for 'Skill tool', 'invoke', 'sub-skill', 'required skill'  3. Add ALL callees (required or optional) to 'calls'  4. Re-run /config-skills to apply

superpowers:brainstorming.note: brainstorming terminal state is invoking writing-plans (confirmed in SKILL.md flow diagram)

superpowers:writing-plans.note: writing-plans invokes either executing-plans (inline) or subagent-driven-development (subagent). Both must be on so any code path works.

superpowers:systematic-debugging.note: systematic-debugging requires test-driven-development for Phase 4 failing test, and verification-before-completion before declaring success

superpowers:subagent-driven-development.note: subagent-driven-development lists these as 'Required workflow skills' in SKILL.md

gstack.note: gstack is a router — it routes user intent to these sub-skills via Skill tool invocation. open-gstack-browser is a pure internal helper.

browse.note: browse uses open-gstack-browser for browser control

qa.note: qa uses browse for page interaction and open-gstack-browser for browser control

qa-only.note: qa-only (report-only variant) uses the same browser infrastructure as qa
